name: bespunky-voice
description: Hear Claude's questions and answer by voice, away from the screen. Questions are asked the way a person asks them (`/speak say`, or automatically with `/speak auto on`). A band above the prompt shows what's said and heard, live, with Replay and Stop. The `voice-conversation` skill + `ask_by_voice` MCP tool run a hands-free back-and-forth. Swappable TTS (espeak-ng / say, upgradable to local Piper), local whisper.cpp STT; audio bridged by the BeSpunky devcontainer.
